name: XLA_DESCRIPT_DETAILS_B
description: This table contains the details of a description. It holds a string of literal and sources in the sequence in which they should appear in the description. A flexfield segment can be specified only if TRANSACTION_COA_ID is not null in the master table XLA_DESCRIPTIONS_B.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Identifier of description detail.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting methods builder context.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_PRIO_ID
columns.description: Identifier of description priority.

columns.name: USER_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Sequence number that is derived from the order of description details.

columns.name: VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates whether the value is a literal or source.

columns.name: SOURCE_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the subledger source or formula is predefined.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of which application owns the source.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is predefined by subledger application.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the transaction information that is used to create journal entries.

columns.name: FLEXFIELD_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Code that is associated with a flexfield segment. For example, GL_ACCOUNT.

columns.name: DISPLAY_DESCRIPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Internal flag, indicate if the flexfield segment is displayed with a meaning or a description.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
